hook: Apple’s hidden Mikey chip protocol finally decoded
hooks: Apple’s hidden Mikey chip protocol finally decoded
Assumption that iPod button protocol was undocumented is broken
Enables adding headset button support to Rockbox in minutes
what_happened: Hemant reverse‑engineered Mikey’s I2C resistive button protocol built it into Rockbox and submitted it to the Rockbox team
why_it_matters: Wired iPod headset buttons could finally work in Rockbox, once the submitted update is merged
the_catch: Long-press isn't supported yet — the center button works as click-only.
caption: The Mikey chip in classic iPods uses an I2C resistive‑encoding protocol for headset buttons, now reverse‑engineered and submitted to Rockbox. How will this revive your old iPod’s remote functions?
alt_text: Carousel on Apple’s Mikey chip: its undocumented headset button protocol was decoded and submitted to Rockbox, but long-press is not yet supported.

es.hook: El protocolo oculto del chip Mikey de Apple, por fin descifrado
es.what_happened: Hemant hizo ingeniería inversa del protocolo I2C de botones resistivos de Mikey, lo integró en Rockbox y lo envió al equipo de Rockbox
es.why_it_matters: Los botones de los auriculares con cable del iPod podrían funcionar por fin en Rockbox, una vez que se integre la actualización enviada
es.the_catch: Aún no se admite la pulsación larga; el botón central solo funciona como clic
